SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. newton (N)
   D. joule (J)

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Heat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Heat.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Heat.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of Matter? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of Matter.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of Matter.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of Matter.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of Matter.

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Removing all vegetation

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Light? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Light.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Light.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Light.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Properties of Matter and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Heat and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
